SCENE: The library, night. Every clock in the room has stopped at nine.
Narration: Rain on the tall windows.
ON SCREEN: Colonel Ash (grey coat, stiff), Miss Cole (dark dress, calm)
CLUE: dinner/c1: The rope was in Colonel Ash's hands, Miss Cole noted.
CLUE: dinner/c2: The poison was Miss Cole's, and everyone knew it.
CLUE: dinner/c3: Colonel Ash had been in the library all evening.
CLUE: dinner/c4: Miss Cole was in the kitchen when the clocks stopped.
EVIDENCE: pocket_watch: A pocket watch, stopped at 9:10, its glass cracked.
COLONEL ASH (cold): Nobody came in. The door was locked.
MISS COLE (calm): I was in the kitchen when the clocks stopped.
INSERT: a broken watch glass on the rug
COLONEL ASH: Then someone is lying.
